mapper.select: SELECT a.id FROM artifact a JOIN invocation i ON i.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND i.id=a.producer_invocation AND i.task_id=a.task_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.task_id=#{taskId} AND a.state='PUBLISHED' AND a.file_receipt IS NOT NULL AND i.tool='present' AND i.state='SUCCEEDED'
SELECT id FROM artifact WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND state<>'PUBLISHED'
